messages:
maria.docs: quick sync — I just opened a docs PR for the offsite installer e2e checklist. It combines the VPC routing verification, NAT gateway expectations, and the KMS/HSM validation steps for disconnected installs. link: https://git.redwood/internals/docs/pulls/4872 :wave:
ajay.sre: thanks! can you paste the minimal network test commands here? we should include a tiny script teams can run in their bastion before starting the installer.
maria.docs: good call. here's the snippet I plan to include under 'preflight checks' (bash):
```bash
# from bastion, verify outbound control-plane access (only allow specific mgmt hosts)
nc -zv internal-mgmt-01.redwood.net 443 || echo "mgmt 443 blocked"
# verify NAT/DNAT is in place for egress from private subnets
# on a node in private subnet: curl -sS --max-time 5 https://ifconfig.co || echo "egress failure"
```
kevin.security: please flag that the PKCS#11 socket path differs between HSM vendors; don't hardcode `/var/run/pkcs11.sock` as canonical. add an example environment block that reads the path from `REDWOOD_PKCS11_SOCKET`.
maria.docs: noted — I'll add env example + note about vendor paths. Also added a short HSM sanity check: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libykcs11.so -L` (vendor-specific) with a caveat.
installer-bot: installer-ci: preflight-check job triggered for PR #4872 — logs at https://ci.redwood/builds/2219 (10 min run) :gear:
sam.qa: ran the script in a staging VPC, hit an ambiguous NAT case: our private nodes returned 403 from the metadata proxy because of a corporate WAF. We should add a troubleshooting section: if metadata proxy blocked, set `--metadata-proxy=none` on the installer and follow manual IP assignment.
ajay.sre: +1 to the troubleshooting note. Also add a quick nftables example for environments that prefer nft vs iptables:
```bash
# allow DNS + HTTPS egress from private subnets
nft add rule inet redwood-out ip daddr 0.0.0.0/0 tcp dport {53, 443} accept
```
kevin.security: also put a short note about kernel seccomp for PKCS#11 drivers — some distros ship hardened profiles that block `mmap` in ways that cause token errors. Recommend `setenforce` or tune profiles, and link to a vendor KB.
maria.docs: adding both nftables and seccomp notes. I want to keep the root checklist short; will put longer troubleshooting as expandable sections. Any objections to calling the doc "offsite-installer-networking-and-crypto-checklist"? Trying to avoid the word 'airgap' in title to be more general.
sam.qa: fine with the name. one more thing — include a quick verification for KMS key usage post-boot: sample curl to operator endpoint that requests a test encrypt/decrypt with the customer key id. Example: `curl -X POST https://localhost:8443/v1/crypto/test -d '{"key_id":"k-123"}'` and expect "ok": true.
kevin.security: add a permission note: ensure the installer service principal has Encrypt/Decrypt on the key. show IAM snippet for common vendors.
maria.docs: perfect. I'll incorporate key-perms snippet and a small JSON example for the test flow. Planning to push an update in ~30m. If CI passes and you all +1, I'll merge and backport to v1.8 docs.
ajay.sre: CI passed for preflight job (installer-bot). LGTM from infra side, left one small nit about wording in the nft example.
kevin.security: LGTM from security after adding pkcs11 socket env and seccomp caveat.
sam.qa: did one quick run with HSM emulator, test encrypt/decrypt succeeded. +1.
maria.docs: thanks team — merging in 15 unless any blockers. I'll ping #release-war-room when backported. :tada:
